capture_source: live capture 2026-11-25: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) calling reset_server_context() on an S/4HANA ABAP system, kernel 793, between two STFC_CONNECTION calls. NI payloads, no length prefix.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. The request is an ordinary zero-parameter invoke of SYSTEM_RESET_RFC_SERVER, sent without a metadata lookup; the reply is an ordinary reply with an extra empty 0x0523 record. Contains no address, user or credential.
notes: The request TLV body (from offset 76) is what Connection._reset_request_tlv() frames; the GW header differs per connection (conversation id at 40-47).
After the reset the reference client re-sends client attributes (0x0007, 0x0011, 0x0012, 0x0013, 0x0008, 0x0006, 0x0130) in its next call; saprfclib does not, see docs/protocol/framing.md.
